extracted.stage: Financial provision action at the Court of Session, proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a Court of Session financial provision action asks whether funding of £21,000 is available, with matrimonial property of around £210,000, and whether we lend in Scotland.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. To consider it further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, the date of the next hearing or proof diet, details of the matrimonial property and any existing charges over it, confirmation of your client's identity and your firm's engagement, and an estimate of costs to proof. It would also help to have confirmation of how the figure of £21,000 is made up. Please note that Lodestar Legal Finance funds legal costs in England and Wales, so we will need to check whether we can assist in this instance. Once we have the above, a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
